critical_code_review_comments: services/cohort_celebrations.py:69 — _already_celebrated uses `func.cast(audit_metadata, String).like('%"threshold": 75%')` to dedupe across DBs. Works on SQLite (TEXT) and Postgres (JSONB casts to text), but the LIKE substring will produce false positives if any other metadata value happens to contain the literal string 'threshold': 75. Low risk because target_type='cohort' + target_id=<cohort> already narrows it, but using `AuditLog.audit_metadata['threshold'].astext == str(threshold)` on Postgres would be safer. For SQLite-only this is fine.

services/cohort_celebrations.py:117 — the inner `_SystemActor` class has `id = None`. audit_service.record on most code paths sets `actor_id = actor.id`, which becomes NULL — verify the DB column allows null (the audit_logs table appears to since system events fire). The actor_email field will also be empty in the resulting audit row. Consider stamping actor_email='system@ifpi.cohort' so it's distinguishable from missing-actor bugs in the audit UI.

services/outbox_worker.py:140 — cohort_celebrations job runs every 60s with max_instances=1 + coalesce=True (good). However if check_cohorts() takes >60s on a tenant with thousands of cohorts the next tick is silently skipped. Recommend logging slow ticks (>30s) and adding a `misfire_grace_time` argument to the job for visibility.

scripts/qa_agents/agent_008_e2e_journey.py:69 — runs `seed.seed_minimal.run_if_empty()` at the start. This is a no-op if the DB has any users, so the test is safe to re-run, but if the seed file is altered while the DB is already partially seeded the assertions on course_id=1 / exam_id=1 will be misleading. Consider pinning by title (already done for course query, but ExamQuestion query relies on the fixed FK).

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ReportsPage.tsx:19 — params include `cohort: cohort || undefined`; when cohort is empty string this correctly omits the param, but TanStack Query's queryKey includes the empty string ['cohort-stats', ''] which is fine. Just be aware switching back to 'All learners' refetches via a fresh key — works as intended.

frontend/src/pages/dashboard/ReportsPage.tsx — there's no loading / empty / error state on `cohortStats` (only render `&& cohortStats`). If the API errors silently the tiles vanish without explanation. Minor UX nit — fine for v1.
